purpose: Expose only the fixed failing boundary and recognized typed fixed code on the two existing private venue HOLD reports; investigate an unclassified failure without changing behavior or claiming no writes.

api.name: _venue_research_diagnostic

output_types.diagnostic_phase: exact str from phase whitelist or UNKNOWN_PHASE
output_types.diagnostic_reason: exact str from a predeclared lookup value or UNCLASSIFIED_EXCEPTION

eligibility: Only type(exception) is ValueError or type(exception) is RuntimeError. Subclasses are ineligible.
Only after exact eligible type: read exception.args; require type(args) is tuple, len(args)==1 and type(args[0]) is str.
Look up the exact argument in the map for that exact type, returning only a predeclared constant map value.
Use no str(), repr(), arbitrary class name, traceback, __cause__, __context__, notes, or custom exception property access.
Use type(phase) is str before exact membership lookup; unknown/custom/hostile phase maps to UNKNOWN_PHASE.
No runtime file reads, imports of provider modules, environment/key reads, mutation, logging, retries, callbacks or I/O in this helper.
api.finite_map_construction_note: The maps below are fully expanded finite literal input/output pairs. Prefix/suffix groups and 400..599 were used only while authoring this contract. The runtime must accept exact keys only, never arbitrary prefix, substring or regexp matches.
